text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the City of Toronto capital spending for the twelve month period ended December 31, 2021. As illustrated in Table 1 below, City's 2021 capital expenditure was $3.545 billion or 67.6% of the 2021 capital budget of $5.245 billion for the period ended December 31, 2021. - Tax Supported Programs and Agencies reported capital expenditures of $2.319 billion representing 61.3% of their collective 2021 Approved Capital Budget of $3.783 billion. - Rate Supported Programs reported capital expenditures of $1.226 billion, representing 83.9% of their collective 2021 Approved Capital Budget of $1.462 billion.
